snippet.title: American Truck Simulator: Louisiana Video Trailer
snippet.description:
The official video trailer for the upcoming Louisiana DLC for American Truck Simulator just arrived!

It won't be long until you are trucking through the beautiful and iconic landscape of this southern state, with historical cities like New Orleans and Baton Rouge, miles and miles of long stretching roads, and also the Mississippi River delta that has helped shape how the area looks today.

Like what you see? Add the Louisiana DLC to your Steam wishlist 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/#game_area_purchase
